user.title: Connect to Roomba
user.description: Enter the robot BLID and local MQTT password. Host is optional: leave blank only if mDNS works from Home Assistant (irobot-<blid>.local); otherwise enter the robot's LAN IP. Last dial attempt: {endpoint}.

data_description.password: Local MQTT password for the robot.
data_description.host: Prefer the robot LAN IP. Leave blank only if mDNS irobot-<blid>.local resolves from the HA host.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to {endpoint} over local MQTT (TLS). See Home Assistant logs for detail.
error.dns_error: Hostname/mDNS lookup failed for {endpoint}. Enter the robot's LAN IP in Host.
error.unreachable: {endpoint} is unreachable from this Home Assistant host (TCP). If scripts on another VM work, check HA OS/container networking, VLANs, and firewall — not a TLS/password problem.
error.tls_error: Reached {endpoint} but the TLS handshake failed (legacy OpenSSL cipher / renegotiation). Not necessarily a wrong IP.
error.auth_invalid: Robot at {endpoint} rejected MQTT username/password (BLID / local password). TCP and TLS succeeded.
error.mqtt_protocol: Robot at {endpoint} rejected the MQTT protocol or client id after TLS succeeded.
error.mqtt_timeout: TCP to {endpoint} is reachable but MQTT CONNACK timed out.

fetch_map.title: Fetch cloud map
fetch_map.description: Enter your iRobot account email and password for this refresh only. Credentials and cloud tokens are discarded after the map is saved. Robot …{blid_suffix}.

data_description.email: Used once to authorize map download; not stored in the config entry.
data_description.password: Used once for this fetch; never saved.
data_description.country: Two-letter country code for cloud endpoint discovery (default US).

error.map_fetch_failed: Could not log in or download the map. Check account credentials and try again.
error.unknown: Unexpected error while fetching the map.
